activation_rule: Pivot-01 no-control center runs first. All ablation definitions are prospective, but no ablation or risk policy can rescue insolvency or a failed core gate.
executable_materialization_rule: Each override requires separate hash-bound executable strategy/config bytes and an A5 manifest/review before registration; this file is not a runtime selector.

ablations.expected_diagnostic: Tests whether quote-volume weighting contributes beyond an ordinary geometric price anchor.
Tests whether short-horizon stabilization/rollover confirmation avoids premature convergence entries.
Directly tests whether excluding gap, tail, drawdown, range, and volatility extremes is essential to solvency and drawdown resilience.
Tests whether the two-rank incumbent buffer materially reduces turnover without erasing the convergence signal.
Tests whether the 63-bar anchor adds stability beyond a more reactive 48-bar anchor.
Tests whether excluding very large anchor deviations avoids value traps and rebound hazards.
Tests the specific contribution of the 20% one-bar quarantine while retaining the other tail filters.
